questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Luxembourg?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Luxembourg article.

questions.proof: The main language is Luxembourgish but French and German is also spoken there.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The countries next to Luxembourg are _____, Germany, and France.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Germany”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Luxembourg article.

questions.proof: The countries next to Luxembourg are Belgium, Germany, and France.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Between 1914 to 1918, Luxembourg was conquered by _____ during World War I.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “during”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Luxembourg article, under the heading “History”.

questions.proof: Between 1914 to 1918, Luxembourg was conquered by Germany during World War I.
